newsitem.title: USA: Dow industrials rally on retail data.
newsitem.headline: Dow industrials rally on retail data.

text.p: The Dow industrial average pushed higher on Thursday after weak May U.S. retail sales numbers helped drive stocks into record territory for the fifth day in a row.

The Dow rose about 82 points, or 1.08 percent, to 7658. The technology-laden Nasdaq composite did not share in the rally but instead hovered just below Wednesday's close, down about 0.6 points to 1407.
The long bond jumped 29/32 at a 6.77 percent yield while the Standard & Poor's futures index was up 8.70 at 888.10.
